title: Mow My World
description:
CCBOT. A much bigger universe.Step into CCBOT's sci-fi universe of block-built starships, enormous machines and worlds to reclaim. Discover the Block System Showcase and the combat adventure offered by UNDEATH WORLD.UNDEATH WORLD: the combat adventureUNDEATH WORLD is optional DLC, sold separately. Take CCBOT into battle across 70 worldlets, descend into optional dungeons and face powerful guardians. Build your loadout with weapons and equipment, develop skills and choose from four difficulty levels.

Return to unlocked worldlets for another fight. Head to the control room for Boss Challenge or Infinite Corridor when you want a different test.

Starships. Machines. Five civilizations.Explore the visual worlds of Human, Awakynet, Cryvum, Bugvex and Meldaen through ships, machines and structures made with the Mow My World block system.

The Block System Showcase images are technology demos, demonstrating our model-building and rendering capabilities. From enormous vessels to intricate mechanical designs, these showcases bring the wider CCBOT universe into view.

Base game and optional DLCThe base game includes CCBOT's Practice sandbox, core creation tools and robot progression. SPIRIT AirMode is included; RAPTOR and PHANTOM flight requires the optional Fly Premium Pack. UNDEATH WORLD and other add-ons are purchased separately.

Available on Windows and macOS.
description_short: A sci-fi robot sandbox with CCBOT, plus showcases of block-built ships and machines. The separately sold UNDEATH WORLD DLC adds combat across 70 worldlets, optional dungeons, bosses, equipment, skills and four difficulty levels.
